// SYNTHETIC ONLY. Infrastructure replacements prove orchestration, not database
// isolation, provider behavior, authorization, factual correctness or media quality.
import { RetryableError } from "workflow";

const state = () => globalThis[Symbol.for("ftrade.workflow.v5.synthetic")];
const record = (name, ...args) => state().calls.push({ name, args });
const scenario = (id) => state().scenarios[id] ?? {};
export async function dispatchManualBrowserSandbox(nodeId, operationId) {
  record("dispatch", nodeId, operationId);
  return scenario(operationId).uncertain
    ? { status: "uncertain" }
    : { status: "running", sessionId: operationId };
}
export async function monitorBrowserSandboxSession(nodeId, sessionId) {
  record("observe", nodeId, sessionId);
  return scenario(sessionId).status ?? "stopped";
}
export async function recoverBrowserSandboxDispatch(nodeId, operationId) {
  record("recover", nodeId, operationId);
  return scenario(operationId).status ?? "stopped";
}
export async function wakeQueuedManualBrowserSandbox(nodeId) {
  record("wake", nodeId);
}
export class CatalogAccessError extends Error {}
export async function claimCatalogAttempt(id) {
  record("catalog.claim", id);
  const item = scenario(id);
  if (item.claimed) return null;
  item.claimed = true;
  if (item.accessDenied) throw new CatalogAccessError("synthetic access denied");
  return item.work;
}
export async function completeCatalogCandidate(id, result) {
  record("catalog.candidate", id, result);
}
export async function completeCatalogParsing(id, document) {
  record("catalog.parsed", id, document);
}
export async function failCatalogAttempt(id, code) {
  record("catalog.failed", id, code);
}
export async function resolveProductAgentModelConfig(id) {
  if (id === "synthetic-config-failure") throw new Error("synthetic model config unavailable");
  return { synthetic: true };
}
export function createProductAgentModel() {
  return { synthetic: true };
}
class CatalogRejectedError extends Error {}
export async function runCatalogProductAgent({ source }) {
  if (source === "synthetic-model-failure") throw new Error("synthetic provider failure");
  if (source === "synthetic-rejected") throw new CatalogRejectedError();
  return { synthetic: true, source };
}
export function isRejectedCatalogOutput(error) {
  return error instanceof CatalogRejectedError;
}
export async function get(path) {
  record("blob.get", path);
  if (path === "synthetic-missing") return null;
  return { statusCode: 200, blob: { contentType: "application/pdf" }, stream: "synthetic-stream" };
}
export async function verifyDocumentUploadBytes() {
  return { sha256: "synthetic-sha", bytes: Buffer.from("SYNTHETIC ONLY") };
}
export async function preprocessProductAgentDocument({ recordId }) {
  record("catalog.preprocess", recordId);
  return { synthetic: true, recordId };
}
export class VideoRetentionError extends Error {}
export class MarketingVideoDraftChangedError extends Error {}
export class MarketingVideoSourceInvalidError extends Error {}
export class VideoRenderCommandError extends Error {}
export async function markVideoJobRunning(id) {
  record("video.running", id);
  const item = scenario(id);
  if (item.retry && !item.retried) {
    item.retried = true;
    throw new RetryableError("synthetic database transient", { retryAfter: 50 });
  }
  if (item.completed) return { status: "succeeded" };
  if (item.failed) return { status: "failed" };
  return { status: "running", requestKey: item.requestKey ?? "synthetic-key" };
}
export function videoProcessingRequestKey() {
  return "synthetic-key";
}
export async function completeVideoJob(id) {
  record("video.completed", id);
  scenario(id).completed = true;
}
export async function failVideoJob(id, code) {
  record("video.failed", id, code);
  scenario(id).failed = true;
}
function project(id) {
  return {
    synthetic: true,
    sourceAssets: [],
    factualClaims: [],
    editDraft: { platform: "synthetic", clips: [], creativeBrief: { synthetic: true } },
    ...scenario(id).project,
  };
}
export async function getMarketingVideoEditProject(id) {
  record("video.project", id);
  if (scenario(id).expired) throw new VideoRetentionError();
  return { project: project(id), state: "VIDEO_DRAFT", version: 1 };
}
export async function assertCurrentProductFactsForVideo() {
  record("video.fact-guard");
}
export async function assertCurrentProductMediaUsageForVideo() {
  record("video.media-guard");
}

export async function beginGuardedMarketingVideoRender(id, actorId) {
  record("video.begin-guard", id, actorId);
  if (scenario(id).expired) throw new VideoRetentionError();
  return project(id);
}
